# langsmith_mcp_vendor_details (Data Source)

Reads what an MCP vendor currently exposes to the workspace: the linked account, the vendor's MCP servers, and the tools it publishes.

Each section is fetched only when its `include_*` flag is set, because a vendor with no linked account answers 404 for `account` while still serving the rest. The payloads are vendor-specific and not pinned down by the API, so they are returned as JSON for `jsondecode()`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each section is fetched only when asked for.
data "langsmith_mcp_vendor_details" "example" {
  vendor_slug   = "slack"
  include_tools = true
}

output "vendor_tools" {
  value = jsondecode(data.langsmith_mcp_vendor_details.example.tools)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vendor_slug` (String) Slug of the MCP vendor (for example `slack`).

### Optional

- `include_account` (Boolean) Fetch the linked vendor account. Defaults to `false`.
- `include_servers` (Boolean) Fetch the vendor's MCP servers. Defaults to `false`.
- `include_tools` (Boolean) Fetch the tools the vendor publishes. Defaults to `false`.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) JSON-encoded account information, when `include_account` is set. Null otherwise.
- `mcp_servers` (String) JSON-encoded list of MCP servers, when `include_servers` is set. Null otherwise.
- `tools` (String) JSON-encoded list of tools, when `include_tools` is set. Null otherwise.
